title: Isabel Hilton
gist: An author index page for Prospect contributing editor Isabel Hilton listing recent pieces, mostly on China, energy and geopolitics. It contains headlines only, with no argued content.

themes.theme: Isabel Hilton's China and energy coverage

insights.claim: Isabel Hilton's recent Prospect pieces focus heavily on China, including Xi Jinping's confidence on the world stage, Zhu Rongji's economic legacy and Trump's China visit.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Signals a regular source of China political commentary on Prospect.
insights.locator: On the world stage, Xi projects confidence

insights.claim: A listed Hilton headline argues that Trump's China visit will expose America's weakness.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Framing of US-China summitry as revealing US weakness; headline only, no supporting argument provided.
insights.quote: Trump’s China visit will expose America’s weakness

insights.claim: A listed Hilton headline argues that Putin's Siberia pipeline is not a done deal.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Questions the certainty of a Russia-China gas pipeline; headline only.
insights.quote: Putin’s Siberia pipeline isn’t a done deal

insights.claim: Hilton's Prospect output also covers space solar power and Elon Musk, under the theme of 'eternal power'.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Space-based solar is on the radar of mainstream commentary; headline only.
